description:
Because:
- FxA Settings and the content server import the allow-list from fxa-shared.
- The code fits a small library under libs/shared.

This commit:
- Adds @fxa/shared/url-allow-list with isAllowed and the convict format.
- Ports the chai spec to Jest with the same 29 cases.
- Points useWebRedirect and router.js to the new alias.
- Keeps an fxa-shared shim for the content-server Node server.

Closes FXA-10652
